name: Sakura no Uta: Sakura no Mori no Ue wo Mau - 10th Anniversary Edition
summary: An anniversary collection for Sakura no Uta: Sakura no Mori no Ue wo Mau, which includes Sakura no Uta Re:Graphic, a brand-new remaster of the original game; Sakura no Uta Append, a fan-disc featuring the after-stories for Rin, Rina, and Yuumi; the soundtrack on a CD, a voice drama CD about the story of Saki and Kenichiro, which was not told in the main story; and a 10th anniversary special booklet.
